author: CBR
description:
Does Yahya Abdul-Mateen II have his own Wonder Man glasses? In this Heroes Journey Podcast clip, Yahya explains he didn’t keep a pair and says the Wonder Man glasses are treated “like the nuclear codes” on set—kept in a case, signed out, and closely controlled. He also confirms he wore the real, actual glasses for appearances.

🎙️ Clip from CBR’s Heroes Journey Podcast – Episode 15 Part 2.
